result:
All tests now pass! The bug was in `/tmp/tacet-bench.BhIQDY/project/tally/invoice.py:42`. The `discount()` method was checking `if self.units() > BULK_UNITS:` when it should check `if self.units() >= BULK_UNITS:`. 

The test expects the bulk discount to apply when the order has exactly 10 units (the minimum bulk quantity), but the original code only applied it for orders with strictly more than 10 units.
